name: BENT OVER DUMBBELL ROWS RIGHT
introduce: Put your left knee and left hand on the bench and your right leg out to the side.\n\nGrab the dumbbell with your right hand, slowly lift it up to your armpit and then lower it. Repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Keep your neck in a neutral position.
Exhale as pulling the dumbbell up, inhale when lowering it.
